name: shop
_doc: The Shop pack (owner request R-0239): 4 shop-* SPECIALIST agents plus the existing payment-integration specialist, which joins by reference (no rename). For web shops and digital products (Etsy, Shopify, WooCommerce, Gumroad). Evidence: a cashflow project and an e-commerce project. forge-router sends a shop request to this pack; forge-pack.cjs (doctor check packs) is red when a pack agent or skill is missing, unrouted or not a registered specialist. Presets are expanded by forge-lane-skills.cjs (--require shop-all,process). Real data only: no invented sales, reviews or metrics; publishing, price changes, spend and messages to buyers stay owner gates.
